text: Finished ep 6 last night. The lake one
omg yes the second victim. i had to pause it twice
The autopsy section. The way the forensic guy described the wounds. I kept rereading it
i skipped that part tbh. the detective walking back to the car after is what got me
The forensic guy said the later cuts were done after she was already gone. Like he just kept going
ok i need to not think about that before coffee
im back. what do u think he was doing it for. like the actual reason
I don't think it's about the reason. I think he needed someone to watch
ugh that's worse
Yeah
he left the letters for the reporter tho. thats a whole ego thing
The letters bother me more than the cuts honestly. He wanted to be read
like hes auditioning
For what
idk. a guy who thinks hes the main character 💀
The podcast host keeps saying he's "meticulous." that word makes me want to throw the phone
lmaoo ok ur right
on lunch. lady came in asking for a refill on something i cant give till monday and tried to argue w me for 10 min
Ugh. Did you hold firm
obviously. she left mad. not my problem 😤
Marking the grade 11 essays. One kid wrote about the ep 3 case for a "true or false" assignment. I didn't assign that
wait is it the same kid who asked u about the bodies in the last one
Different kid. She was fine. Just a lot of detail about the mother
ok thats creepy
It's a kid writing about a podcast. She probably just liked the mother part
off work finally. want to do the thing tmrw? the market or just brunch
Brunch. The market will be packed
bet. i'll pick the place
Dinner done. The psychology part keeps me up honestly
which part. the letters or the watching thing
The watching thing. Thinking about him sitting somewhere while it happens. Just watching someone decide what's next
ok im not gonna think about that tonight
also im sorry i made u go back to it
You didn't make me. I'm the one who picked it up again
still. u know i always do this
It's fine. It's a good episode. It just gets in
going to bed early, got a 7am thing tomorrow. u ok?
Yeah. Going to read something boring
ok night. dont reread the autopsy part
Wasn't going to
Still up. The lake episode is still going around in my head. Don't worry about it
up?? slept like garbage
Barely. Brunch still on?
yes 11 at the egg place on ossington. i already put our name in 😊
Fine. I'll be there at 11
ok good. dont bring the podcast into it
Wasn't going to
home. that was nice. the eggs were overcooked but the coffee was good
Same. I'm going to nap until the essays start yelling at me
manager just texted, wants me in tues 7am for inventory bc the tech quit. so my week is gone 🙃
Can you say no?
i can but then she stops giving me the good shifts lol
That's a real thing?
its a whole thing here. the pharmacy is a little kingdom
Ok. Sorry. That's annoying
its fine. im gonna nap and be mad at her in my sleep
Marking done. Three of the essays are about the lake case. I'm not reading any more of those tonight
lol tell them to write about anything else. pizza or a dog or smth
I did. One of them wrote about a dog. It was about the lake case
Going to bed. Are you going in tues?
ya. 7am. sending u a picture of me crying in the parking lot in advance
Night
at work. the fridge has a sign on it that says TECH WANTED in marker and someone already crossed out WANTED
Is that a good sign or a bad sign
its a sign that people are quitting
First period. A grade 9 has discovered the word "unhinged" and is using it on everything, including the thermostat
lmaooo the thermostat
He said it was unhinged that it was set to 19
lunch. guy wanted his bp pills early bc hes going out of town. told him insurance says no. he said he'll drive to the other location. ok
Ok
ok something happened. dont freak out
Ok. Tell me

guy came to the counter and asked how many of his moms sleeping pills it would take to not wake up. like he said it so calm. i said id have to get the pharmacist and he said "its fine i was kidding" but he wasnt looking at me when he said it
Katie
i got rob. rob went back and talked to him in the consult room for like 20 min. his wife came in and rob told her to take him to emerg. i think they went. i dont know if they went
Are you ok
shaky. hands are doing a thing. rob said i did the right thing and i keep thinking i should have said something different when he first came up
You went and got Rob. That's the thing you're supposed to do. You didn't have to know what to say
yeah
rob has to write it up so ill be filling out a form for the rest of my life lol
Do you want me to come by after your shift
u dont have to. ur marking
The marking can wait. I'd rather sit with you
ok maybe. i'll text u when im out. 6ish
out. u still want to come
Yes. Leaving now. Ossington or the apartment
apartment. im not up for going anywhere
Ok
Home. Are you good
yeah. thx for coming. i think the wine helped and also the fact that u made me eat soup
Good. Text me when inventory is done tomorrow
ur gonna get the crying parking lot pic again 😭
I'll look forward to it
still up. not thinking about the lake guy. thinking about the guy at the counter
Ok. I'm up too
dont say anything just wanted to say it
Ok. Going to sit here for a bit then
